blocks.text: MANILA — The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) and Japan Coast Guard (JCG) will conduct an anti-piracy exercise in Manila Bay on Sunday, October 18, to strengthen maritime security cooperation and enhance their capabilities in responding to piracy incidents.
